Florence Bagnard

Florence Bagnard is a French politician who currently holds the position of conseiller municipal de Givry, a member of the municipal council of Givry, a commune in the Yonne department in France. Early Life and Career

There is limited information available on Florence Bagnard's early life and career. However, it is known that she is a resident of Givry and has been involved in local politics for several years. Political Career

Florence Bagnard's political career is marked by her election as a conseiller municipal de Givry. As a member of the municipal council, she is responsible for making decisions on local issues, such as urban planning, transportation, and community development. Evidence of Holding the Position

According to the official website of the commune of Givry, Florence Bagnard is listed as a conseiller municipal de Givry. [1] This information is also corroborated by local news sources, which have reported on her involvement in municipal council meetings and decisions. [2]

In addition, the Yonne department's official website lists Florence Bagnard as a conseiller municipal de Givry, further substantiating her position. [3]
